title: Valid Anagram
statement: Given two strings s and t, determine if they are anagrams of each other. An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of another, typically using all the original letters exactly once.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters

visibleExamples.explanation: Both strings contain the same characters with the same frequencies.
The strings contain different characters, so they are not anagrams.
The strings contain the same characters in different order.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return type are primitives (str and bool).
